newsitem.title: IRAN: Iranian police clash with smugglers, seize opium.
newsitem.headline: Iranian police clash with smugglers, seize opium.

text.p: Police in northern Iran seized some 500 kg (1,100 lb) of opium after clashing with a gang of armed smugglers, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Tuesday.
It said police seized the drugs and arrested 11 smugglers after wounding four other traffickers in the shoot-out outside the city of Gorgan last week.
The daily Kayhan on Tuesday said police in the town of Mehriz in central Iran seized 235 kg (520 lb) of drugs hidden in a car.

Iran, where officials say there are about half a million drug addicts, is a key transit route for narcotics smuggled to Europe via Turkey from Afghanistan and Pakistan -- the so-called "Golden Crescent".
